A spinning ball drags air faster round one side than the other, so the pressure difference nudges it off a straight line — physicists call it the Magnus effect. ⚽ The curve grows as the ball slows near the end, which is why the bend looks so sudden. Same physics as a table-tennis topspin dip.

Pakistan's fast bowlers made it famous decades ago.
